analysis:
Integrated all 21 units (39-59): production Swift changes in ProviderLoop (+ModelLoading, +ModelSelection, +ModelSwitch, +Prefetch, +PrefetchPublication, +Preload, +Serve, +StartupPreload), ModelPrefetchCoordinator, ProviderLoopConfig, StartCommand (+Autopilot/+Modes/+Picker), ScheduledWindowSelection and the new AutopilotDownloadCommands and AutopilotStatusCommand. The rest are test-only plus docs and changelog. No concrete security regression is supported by the visible evidence.

Security-relevant behavior: Autopilot gains a default-on, consent-gated download path and a wider Autopilot set built from cached verified catalog builds. A hold/adoption lifecycle and a transition watchdog are added. Docs and tests state that downloads never load or advertise a model, that the set requires a verified weight hash, that carried-over cached builds are re-hashed each window (ScheduledWindowSelection head ~73), and that adoption ends on consent revocation, unload, retirement, failed self-test or an unverifiable hash. Prefetch for non-ordinary models is routed to handleAutopilotDownloadRequest (Prefetch.swift 46-57). ModelPrefetchCoordinator's publish hook can refuse, yielding .failed rather than .verified, which is fail-safe. The weight-hash and prefix-cache paths (T-012, T-027, T-041) and the attestation, App Attest and encryption paths (TB-009, TB-011, T-053) are not visibly touched.

Unverified because the definitions are outside the supplied batch: autopilotServesModel versus autopilotAllowsModel, joinsAutopilotSetWhenVerified, AutopilotBuildEligibility, AutopilotStartInventory, AutopilotDownloadLedger and the disk guard, autopilotDownloadCoordinator and the candidate-verification implementation, the end calls pairing transitionGenerations.begin, and how autopilotCachedBuildHashes is sourced. Also unverified: the unrequested-download disk-fill risk (T-016), whether a hold can starve ordinary serving (T-029), and whether the new autopilotHistory detail string can carry sensitive data. A later pass on those companion files must confirm weight-hash verification before adoption or advertisement, consent gating, and download integrity.
